text.tspan: Public attitudes to dietary choices and meat-eating in the United States

text.tspan: The surveys measured attitudes towards animal farming in the United States. 1,000-1,500 adults were surveyed each year.
Results are weighted to be representative of age, gender, region, ethnicity, and income.
